parameters.name: cluster_id
parameters.description: The cluster ID. If you specify a cluster ID, the system queries the list of components available for the cluster, and other parameters are ignored.

parameters.name: cluster_spec
parameters.description: The cluster specifications. If cluster_id is specified, this parameter is ignored. The region_id, cluster_type, profile, cluster_spec, and cluster_version parameters must be specified together.

parameters.name: cluster_type
parameters.description: The cluster type. If cluster_id is specified, this parameter is ignored. The region_id, cluster_type, profile, cluster_spec, and cluster_version parameters must be specified together.

parameters.name: cluster_version
parameters.description: The cluster version. If cluster_id is specified, this parameter is ignored. The region_id, cluster_type, profile, cluster_spec, and cluster_version parameters must be specified together.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The cluster subtype. If cluster_id is specified, this parameter is ignored. The region_id, cluster_type, profile, cluster_spec, and cluster_version parameters must be specified together.

parameters.name: region_id
parameters.description: The region ID. If cluster_id is specified, this parameter is ignored. The region_id, cluster_type, profile, cluster_spec, and cluster_version parameters must be specified together.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: The component version. If this parameter is not specified, the latest available version of the component is queried.
